jobs.prompt: Correct original female incline neutral-grip dumbbell press artwork. Preserve female identity detailed silver anatomy, 45degree bench, full opaque black shirt and knee-length shorts covering back/seat/crotch, feet/body/bench framing and two start/end press poses. Maintain real supported head/back, stable feet and arms no extra limbs. Primary upper-chest red only as soft tint on opaque folded black textile. All figures and weights inside margins, white background, no text.
